name: Snowflake Plugin
description: Development Snowflake plugin for Scott F — sample toolbar items, views, modals, and setup assistant fields.

fields.content:
Welcome to Scott F's Dev Plugin

This sample plugin lets your team capture quick notes from the toolbar and review them in one place. Configure the options below to control how it behaves.

fields.label: Show Welcome Banner
fields.tooltip: Display the greeting banner at the top of the Notes view.

fields.label: Enable Quick Note
fields.tooltip: Allow capturing quick notes from the toolbar.

fields.content:
Notes Storage (optional)

Pick a Kizen object and map the title/body fields to permanently store quick notes as records. Leave blank to keep notes for the current session only.

fields.label: Notes Object
fields.tooltip: The Kizen custom object where quick notes will be stored as records.

fields.label: Note Title Field
fields.tooltip: Field that stores each note's title. Defaults to the object's primary (name) field if left blank.

fields.label: Note Body Field
fields.tooltip: Field that stores each note's details/body.

fields.label: Note Type Field
fields.tooltip: Field that stores the note type (Task, Idea, or Reminder).

fields.label: Urgent Field
fields.tooltip: Yes/No field that stores whether the note is marked urgent.
